content: Customer Dhruv Kapoor called insurance agent Neha Kapoor to verify COVID cancellation and trip extension policies for his October trip. Neha confirmed that cancellations and extensions up to 7 days are covered if notified 24 hours in advance, though pet care is excluded. Neha also resent the claim form PDF and mobile-friendly policy documents, and walked Dhruv through the step-by-step claims filing process.

action_items: Resend the claim form PDF to the customer
Resend the policy document in a mobile-friendly format
